user.title: iLMeteo.it — API key
user.description:
Enter the API key generated in your iLMeteo.it account area.

Each key has a daily request limit, shared by every location using it: refreshing every 30 minutes, one location uses about 100 requests a day.

details.title: iLMeteo.it — Instance details
details.description:
Selected location: **{place}**

Choose a custom display name (optional), which dedicated sensors to create, and configure weather alert notifications.

**Weather alert notifications**
On by default. Uses the iLMeteo data already fetched as a heuristic source. To add official Civil Protection bulletins, install the DPC Alert integration by caiosweet and select sensor.dpc_alert and/or sensor.dpc_vigilance in the dedicated fields.

**Additional push notifications**
The native persistent notification is always sent. You can add one or more mobile devices with the companion app installed.

All settings can be changed later from Options.
